rows.en:
Wow, I've wandered into
somewhere pretty hectic...
rows.notes: Male, frd_rnk_009 (ending: backstage at Ranka's concert).

rows.en: Where's Ranka's dressing room...?
Oh, here it is...
Ye~s?
rows.notes: x3, Ranka answering the knock; also the female player in frd_she_007.

rows.en: It's me.

Oh, \p-kun?!
Hang on, I'll open it right now!!
Congrats on your concert!

Thank you!
Sorry for making you come all this way.

No, I'm the one who should be sorry
for dropping in when you're busy...

These flowers are to celebrate!
They're from everyone at Mihoshi!
Wow~! They're beautiful~!!
I'm really looking forward to the concert.

Yeah!
It's my first concert since we reached
the new planet! I'm all fired up!!
rows.notes: x2, Ranka; kiai juubun ganbaru yo.

rows.en: (Yep, that's the same old energetic Ranka!)

\p-kun!
Keep cheering me on, okay?!
rows.notes: Male, Ranka; kore kara mo ouen shite ne.

rows.en: Yeah, I'll always be cheering for you!

Ranka ending (male).
Slot filler for female.
rows.notes: Developer placeholder under Alto's name plate, translated literally like c06488.

rows.en:
Ranka ending (female).
Slot filler for male.
rows.notes: Developer placeholder under Alto's name plate, translated literally like c06489.

rows.en:
I might've wandered into
somewhere pretty hectic...
Where's Ranka-chan's dressing room...?
It's me.

Oh, \p-chan?!
Hang on, I'll open it right now!!

I'm the one who should be sorry
for dropping in when you're busy.
(That's the same old energetic Ranka-chan!)

\p-chan!
Keep cheering me on, okay?!
I'll always be cheering for you!
Hello, \p-kun.
rows.notes: x3, Ranka (frd_rnk_101); also Nanase in nml_nns_001.

rows.en: Hey, Ranka. What are you doing here?
Well, I had a little errand at school...
Oh, I know! Shall we walk home together?
Sure, let's stop somewhere on the way.

We've got tests coming up soon.
Are you studying properly, Ranka?

Oh, I forgot!!
Phew... That was a close one...

Then you'd better study
when you get home.
Yes, you're right!
Hello, \p-chan.
Ranka-chan, what are you doing here?
Okay! Let's stop somewhere on the way home.

We've got tests coming up soon.
Are you studying, Ranka-chan?
Well, I had another errand at school...

Oh, I know! Shall we go have some fun
somewhere?
Sure, let's go have some fun~
By the way, how did your last test go?
Mmm~, so-so, I guess?

You say that, but I bet you actually
got a good score, didn't you?

No, really, it was average!
Totally average!
Hey, Ranka-chan. What are you doing here?
Yeah, let's go have some fun.

(Today I came to Central Park
to hang out with Ranka.)
\p-kun, sorry to keep you waiting!
Oh, okay. That's good, then.
rows.notes: x2, Ranka; answers the player's shared 'I just got here myself' (c09418/c07338).

rows.en: Let's take a little walk.

It's a nice place, isn't it?
There are so many animals and plants.

There's something here you just don't feel
in everyday life. You don't get to see
this much green, either.

Yeah. Every now and then,
we need to take a breather like this...

Mmm~!
This feels great!

(I came to Central Park
to hang out with Ranka-chan.)
\p-chan, sorry to keep you waiting!

There's something here you just don't feel
in everyday life. You don't get to see
this much green, either.

(I came to Central Park
with Ranka again today.)
\p-kun, you're la~te!

Sorry, sorry.
I kind of overslept...

Geez, you've even got bedhead.
Get it together, okay?
Ahaha... I've learned my lesson...

I'm jealous... I'd love to live
surrounded by green~

That might be pretty inconvenient, though.
Without electricity, it's pitch-black after dark,
and even cooking is a real chore.

That's why it's nice to come
once in a while, right?
Hmm, I guess you're right...
\p-chan, you're la~te!

Geez, your hair's a total mess, you know?
You're a girl, so you've gotta look neat...
Ahaha... Lesson learned, lesson learned.

That might be pretty inconvenient, though.
Without electricity, it's pitch-black after dark,
and even cooking is a real chore.
